title: An IPv4 subnet capacity worksheet
method: Synthetic ordinary AWS /24 subnet: 256 total minus five reserved minus 160 workload and thirty supporting interfaces = 61 remaining. This is an allocation example, not a universal reservation rule across providers or BYOIP configurations.
alt: An IPv4 subnet capacity worksheet: Workload interfaces 160 IPv4 addresses, Supporting interfaces 30 IPv4 addresses, AWS reserved 5 IPv4 addresses, Unallocated addresses 61 IPv4 addresses. Illustrative inputs.
